summary: Flutamide carries the strongest type of warning from the FDA due to reports of hospital stays and rare deaths from liver failure, alongside warnings for blood vessel and skin harm [3][4]. The drug is only intended for men, as it is not approved for women and can harm an unborn baby during pregnancy [4]. Additionally, a small computer model—not tests on actual people—rated the drug's risk as high for liver harm and low for heart harm [M].
